# PerleMama Lactation

> Bilingual (English & Afrikaans) breastfeeding support with Annette Nel, LC (CBI), based in Stellenbosch, Western Cape, South Africa.

Site: https://perlemamalactation.co.za
Phone / WhatsApp: 076 183 6080
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/398919377142731

## Services

- Home visits: https://perlemamalactation.co.za/home-visits/
- Online consultation (South Africa): https://perlemamalactation.co.za/online-consultation/
- Stellenbosch in-person: https://perlemamalactation.co.za/stellenbosch-clinic/
- Afrikaans home: https://perlemamalactation.co.za/af/

## Booking

WhatsApp is the primary booking channel.

## Notes

Annette Nel is a Lactation Counselor (LC, CBI) and La Leche League SA Leader for Stellenbosch — not an IBCLC. Educational support only; seek medical care for emergencies.
